title: fix(plugin-dashboard,plugin-designer): a declared measure that is not rendered is reported; column / horizontal-bar draw every measure; the pickers follow the widget door (objectui#8894)
body:
Fixes #8894

Clause-②: no

Implements triage's restated scope for the card (comment `5921125865`, Q2, items 1 to 4) under the PM claim `5942809527` (branch `claude/issue-8894-measure-not-rendered`, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01YLg8XqWGJ785fwQ5v4pH37`).

## What changed

**1. `column` and `horizontal-bar` draw every measure of a dimensionless widget** (`packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DatasetWidget.tsx`). They join `MEASURE_AXIS_CHART_FAMILIES`, the bar family's measure transposition from objectui#11261. `CHART_TYPE_MAP` keeps both under their own names, so membership was the whole change: the chart renderer already draws a transposed `horizontal-bar` with the category axis on y. Measured in a rendered test with real Recharts marks: a three-measure `column` paints 3 bar rectangles with x-axis ticks `Revenue / Cost / Margin`; a three-measure `horizontal-bar` paints 3 with the same ticks on the y axis, and its x axis carries the value scale. A one-measure dimensionless widget keeps the tile on both types.

**2. The diagnostic's condition is "a declared measure is not rendered".** One derivation, `renderedMeasures`, is computed from the branch decision (the tile renders the first measure, every other branch renders all of them) and read by both the tile and the diagnostic. The diagnostic fires on `values` minus `renderedMeasures`, never on a type list. It still fires for the seven dimensionless types that keep the tile (pie, donut, funnel, scatter, radar, treemap, sankey) and for a stored metric-family row; it is silent for a table, a dimensioned chart and a one-measure tile.

The message is reworded as a diagnostic. It names the widget, what it renders, the measures it queried and never displayed, and points to the `replacement` of the spec's ADR-0087 entry `dashboard-widget-metric-family-multi-measure-refused` (the id is checked against the installed spec's `MIGRATIONS_BY_MAJOR`). It names no widget types and gives no advice of its own. The old advice, "use a widget that renders every measure (table, pivot or a chart)", was wrong on the dimensionless arm and is gone. The stale comment "an author may legally declare three measures", false for the metric family since spec 17.5.0, is rewritten in the component and in the pin file header. The PR objectui#11257 report named this PR as the carrier for that edit.

**3. The authoring pickers follow the widget door, with no type list.** A new module-private helper `measureRefusal` (`packages/plugin-dashboard/src/measureRefusal.ts`, not re-exported) asks objectui's `DashboardWidgetSchema` mirror (`@object-ui/types/zod`, which re-attaches the spec's `checkDashboardWidgetMetricMeasureArity`) for its `custom` issue at `values`. The probe carries only `id` / `type` / `values` / `dimensions`, because measured on the mirror a numeric `id`, a non-string dimension or a malformed `title` aborts zod before the object-level checks run and hides the verdict. Asking the door instead of reusing PR objectui#11257's test-side family derivation means objectstack#20958's set is followed automatically once a spec release carries it and the mirror re-attaches it (its own pin `spec-object-refinements-7715` forces that re-attachment).
- `WidgetConfigPanel` (plugin-dashboard): when one more measure would be refused, the add control is not offered. When the current measures are already refused (a stored document, or a type switched under them), the door's own message is shown under the chips (`role="alert"`), and both chips stay on screen.
- `DashboardEditor` (plugin-designer): this editor authors no measures, but its type picker could turn a stored multi-measure `bar` into a `metric`, and `DashboardDesignPage`'s save swallows the refusal. A type the door refuses the widget's measures under is now a disabled `option`, and a change to it writes nothing. A stored widget that is already refused keeps its type and shows the door's message. plugin-designer does not depend on plugin-dashboard, so the probe is a private copy there that names its twin.

**4. Pins.** Triage's four:
- dimensionless `horizontal-bar` renders three measures with no diagnostic (and `column`), in `DatasetWidget.dimensionlessMeasures-11261.test.tsx`;
- dimensionless `pie` with two measures warns and names the dropped one;
- stored two-measure `metric` warns, and the test asserts the door refuses that document;
- dimensionless `table` does not warn (control).

The last three are in `DatasetWidget.unrenderedMeasures-8894.test.tsx`. PR objectui#11278's nine "as measured" rows are now two delivered SUBJECT rows (`column`, `horizontal-bar`) and seven CONTROL rows that still drop. The finders in both files key on the kept phrase "Queried and then never displayed", so the silence controls cannot pass by matching nothing after the rewording. New: `WidgetConfigPanel.measureDoor-8894.test.tsx` and `DashboardEditor.measureDoor-8894.test.tsx`. Both read the family off the spec's own rule at run time, and assert a shown refusal EQUALS the spec's message for the same document. objectui#8887's caption pins (`DatasetWidget.subCaption.test.tsx`) are untouched and green.

**5. Docs and changesets.** A section "How many measures a widget renders" is added to `packages/plugin-dashboard/README.md` and `content/docs/plugins/plugin-dashboard.mdx`. The changesets are `.changeset/8894-dashboard-measures-not-rendered.md` (plugin-dashboard, patch) and `.changeset/8894-designer-type-picker-measure-door.md` (plugin-designer, patch).

## Zone 2 measurements

1. **Family membership plus renderer:** TRUE. At `7728c67c86` the set was `bar / line / area / combo`, read off `CHART_TYPE_MAP`, which maps `column` and `horizontal-bar` to themselves. Adding them was enough; marks and labels are measured above.
2. **One place to derive "what the branch renders":** TRUE (`renderedMeasures`). Its sub-assumption is FALSE: "a dimensioned `pie` with two measures renders both as series". Measured with a temporary rendered probe that was never committed: `DatasetWidget` hands both measures to the chart as series, but the shared chart renderer's pie arm binds the first series only (`pieDataKey = series[0]?.dataKey`). The probe drew 2 sectors (the two stage buckets of `revenue`), with no trace of `cost` and no warning. The donut, funnel, treemap and sankey arms read `series[0]` the same way (read at source, not rendered). Under the triage rule "computed from what the chosen branch renders", `DatasetWidget`'s branch does hand the measure on, so its diagnostic stays silent there. The drop happens one layer down, in plugin-charts. It is outside this card and reported, not changed (see Acceptance notes); no pin asserts that this case is correct.
3. **The installed spec does not carry objectstack#20958:** TRUE. `node_modules/@objectstack/spec` is 17.5.0. Its `DashboardWidgetSchema` has the metric-family arity check (`SINGLE_MEASURE_WIDGET_TYPES`, module-private) and no dimensionless refusal. Measured on both doors: a dimensionless two-measure `pie` / `bar` is accepted. The pickers therefore act on the metric family today, by asking the door.
4. **Derive the family at run time, no second list:** applied as a stronger form. The pickers ask the door per widget instead of deriving a type set. The two new test files derive the family exactly as PR objectui#11257 did.
5. **The door's replacement:** the ADR-0087 entry `dashboard-widget-metric-family-multi-measure-refused` is present in the installed registry (`MIGRATIONS_BY_MAJOR[18].semantic`, with fields `id / surface / replacement / reason / acceptanceCriteria`). The diagnostic points to its `replacement` by id and adds no wording of its own. The pickers show the door's message verbatim.

## Tests and gates

Run from the worktree root through the shared verify lock (`OS_VERIFY_LOCK_SLOT=issue-8894-dev`). Code at `77fcba3`; the docs commit `1f43362` touches only `.md` / `.mdx`, and every reader of those files was re-run on `1f43362`.

- Closure build `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/plugin-dashboard^...' --filter '@object-ui/plugin-designer^...' build`: VERDICT command-exit 0 (17 packages). Then both packages' own `build`: command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-dashboard type-check`: exit 0. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-designer type-check`: exit 0. Both echo `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`.
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-dashboard/ packages/plugin-designer/` plus the cross-package readers of the changed sources (sdui-parser `dashboard-widget-options-census`, scripts `unconsumed-widget-option-claim-6186`, types `dashboard-widget-metric-measure-door-8894` / `chart-series-keys-7546` / `spec-object-refinements-7715`, i18n `residue-namespaces-3546` / `dashboard-emptyState-keys-retired-7125`, plugin-report `chartCategoryConvergence`, data-objectstack `queryDataset`, scripts `check-control-bytes`): **Test Files 203 passed (203), Tests 1964 passed / 6 skipped (1970)**, VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Doc readers on `1f43362` (console and cli `unfulfilled-chart-stubs-8760`, plugin-dashboard `readme-dashboard-examples-spec-valid`, types `dashboard-widget-slot-component-arm-7952`, scripts `check-doc-component-types` / `check-readme-exports` / `markdown-test-inputs` / `unconsumed-widget-option-claim-6186`): **8 files, 288 tests passed**, command-exit 0.
- eslint over the 8 changed lintable files: exit 0, 0 errors. Narrowing proof:
  - (1) the checked population is what the root `eslint.config.js` applies to `**/*.{ts,tsx}`, the config every package `lint` script resolves;
  - (2) the `--format json` result count is 8 files;
  - (3) invariance: the config uses `tseslint.configs.recommended`, not type-checked, with no `parserOptions.project`, and no `eslint-rules/` rule reads another file. So this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file. Per-rule warning counts for each edited file are identical at base `7728c67` and head: DatasetWidget 10, WidgetConfigPanel 23, DashboardEditor 4. The 3 new files have 0.
- Gates, each exit 0: `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` ("0 new citation(s)"), `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `changeset:check`, `check:installed-pin-claims`, `check:doc-types`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:doc-example-ids`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `docs:check-links`, `markdown-test-inputs --audit`. `check-changeset-presence` reports "8 source file(s) of 2 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 2 changeset(s)". `check-governed-queue-guard --test` reports NOT GOVERNED.
- `check:spec-floors`: plugin-dashboard and plugin-designer were built and judged with no finding. The run's 9 remaining findings are all `no-artifact` on packages this diff does not touch (not built locally). NOT MEASURED for those, reason: prerequisite. CI builds them.
- NOT MEASURED, reason: prerequisite (they need the whole-tree build that CI runs): `check:doc-examples`, `check:doc-snippets`, `check:readme-exports` (exit 2 or "population COLLAPSED"). The docs edit adds no code fence, and `UNGATED_EXAMPLES` keys by symbol and ordinal, not by line.

## Ablations

Run from committed `77fcba3` with objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode. Each anchor hit exactly once, the on-disk anchor count went 1 to 0 and the replacement 0 to 1, the blob hash moved, the restore was armed on EXIT / INT / TERM, and the restore was proven by blob equals HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty. No `dist/` is involved: every subject is imported relatively or through the root vitest `src` aliases.

- **A.** Family set without `column` / `horizontal-bar` (blob `5bced122` to `f925e122`): exactly the 2 new SUBJECT rows go red by name; 25 rows stay green.
- **B.** Diagnostic condition voided (prefixed with `false &&`): all 8 SUBJECTs in the 8894 file go red, plus the 8 rows in the 11261 file that assert the diagnostic on tile shapes (the two-measure metric control and the seven dimensionless controls). All silence controls stay green: 16 failed, 23 passed.
- **C.** `measureRefusal` never refuses: all 16 WidgetConfigPanel SUBJECTs go red; every control stays green (16 failed, 36 passed).
- **D.** DashboardEditor probe never refuses: all 3 SUBJECTs go red; both controls stay green.

## Patch round 1 (summary written by the dispatching seat)

The seat's REWORK record is card comment `5943508777`; the dev's round report is `5944021621`. Head `cb07aec`. Runtime source is unchanged since `77fcba3`.

- **`aed5fe6`, prose.** The README and the docs page scope the console warning to what `DatasetWidget`'s own branch keeps off the screen, and name the renderer-side gap without promising behaviour: a dimensioned `pie` / `donut` / `funnel` / `treemap` / `sankey` with several measures draws only the first (objectui#11417). The two changesets are reconciled as described in the Acceptance notes.
- **`0099cf3`, console-starter closure test.** Its walker resolved every workspace specifier to `packages/PKG/src` plus the subpath, which cannot reach `@object-ui/types/zod` (`src/zod/index.zod.ts`); this PR adds the first importers of that subpath inside the closure. The walker now resolves through the first matching alias-table entry, as `@rollup/plugin-alias` does, and keeps the old guess when no entry matches. Three fixtures pin that a missing or mis-ordered subpath entry is still reported, and an ablation restoring the old guess turns exactly the two expected rows red.
- **`cb07aec`, the ADR-0087 registry read in `DatasetWidget.unrenderedMeasures-8894.test.tsx`.** The pinned `@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0 exports `MIGRATIONS_BY_MAJOR` from its root and has no `./migrations` subpath; objectstack `main` moved the chain to that subpath (`migrations-entry-split`), and the console's spec-dist injection cannot serve a subpath. The test reads the root through a dynamic import, typed as a plain record, so it compiles against both the pin and `main`. With no fallback, it fails by name at the pin bump that passes the split, and tells that PR to import from `/migrations`.
- **CI on `cb07aec`:** 43 check runs, 40 success, 3 skipped by design, 0 failed (`Spec Main Shape Gate`, all eight test shards and `Build & E2E` among them).
- **Console bundle:** `assert-types-zod-stays-lazy` passes, and the `@object-ui/types/zod` validators stay out of the eager closure (330 of 2450 chunks eager; `dist/eager-closure.json` lists no plugin-dashboard, plugin-designer or types-zod chunk). On lazy paths, the types-zod chunk (45.92 kB gzip) is now also pulled by the dashboard and dashboard-designer chunks on first open.

## Acceptance notes

- **Out of scope, reported for the seat to file (class a):** a dimensioned `pie` / `donut` / `funnel` / `treemap` / `sankey` with two or more measures passes every door (objectui mirror and spec, measured) but draws only its first measure. The shared chart renderer binds `series[0]` on those arms and says nothing. This sits in plugin-charts `AdvancedChartImpl`, one layer below the branch decision this card reads. Measured on pie; the other four were read at source. Filed by the seat as objectui#11417.
- The pending `.changeset/8894-metric-tile-unrendered-measures-speak.md` (from PR objectui#8905, not yet released) is reconciled in `aed5fe6` (patch round 1): the file and its front matter are kept, and its sentences that went false ("has always been legal", the old message wording, "tracked separately") are rewritten to the current state.
- `WidgetConfigPanel`'s type select is the shared `ConfigPanelRenderer` select, which has no disabled-option support. So a type switch there is answered by showing the door's refusal at once, not by disabling the option. `DashboardEditor`'s native select disables it.
- The diagnostic still fires for the seven dimensionless types until objectstack#20958's refusal is installed. At that point those documents are door-refused, and the diagnostic covers them as stored rows.
